body:
This submits **A zero-free half-plane from finite ordinary source moments**, by Hailey Collet: a standalone proof of the strict boundary **Re(s) > 8747729897/10000000000 = 0.8747729897**, or **c = 1252270103/10000000000**, for every Dirichlet character and positive modulus, excluding the principal pole. The paper also supplies the finite-order Hecke statement over Q(√−3) and the zeta consequence.

The contribution follows the Track B structural-writeup format, adds a results row and contributor credit, and links the paper and evidence from the current-state summaries. It includes:

- The **138-page standalone paper**, PDF and complete TeX, containing the direct proof route and exact rational certificates.
- The **complete used Lean closure: 6,471 modules**, exact source inventory, Lean 4.34.1/package pins, attribution and source provenance, frozen at tracker revision `ac76d5ef6008d976a7b8f3c1d921af2317e79ce9`.
- Successful local compiler/audit output and source/object/receipt hashes, with a small package-integrity checker. The externally authored manuscript/code retain Apache-2.0 and inherited notices; new integration documentation follows this repository's MIT license.

**Verification completed:** the entire used closure compiled in resumed development: a 6,431-module clean prefix plus all 40 missing modules with whole-process exit 0. The separate **`Candidate.bound` axiom audit exited 0 with only `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound`**, with no `sorryAx`. Earlier finite scalar development passed **657 modules / 2,953 theorem and lemma audits**; divisor-kernel/absolute-mass and squarefree-restoration components passed **14 modules / 94 theorem audits** and **22 modules / 96 declaration audits**, respectively. The package states the exact scope and dependency reuse for each check.

The protected tracker attempt additionally completed **2,923 cache hits + 3,305 fresh module compilations = 6,228/6,471 modules** before its shared three-hour budget expired. A complete fresh final replay and exact-head canonical Comparator plus Lean/NanoDa/con-ron endpoint acceptance remain pending; no completed three-kernel endpoint certificate is claimed. The same frozen source is in [tracker PR #69](https://github.com/GTimG/QuasiRiemannTracker/pull/69), with [the protected run](https://github.com/GTimG/QuasiRiemannTracker/actions/runs/39666255945). This submission provides the written proof and completed formal-development evidence for this repository's review model.

Local package hashes, all 6,471 archived source hashes, 41 successful receipt/log bindings and final axiom output were checked. The repository's existing `certify.py` also exited 0 with adaptive endpoint `True` and all listed checks `OK`; that reproduces the existing baseline rather than certifying the new endpoint.

I would also like to introduce **[QRH-Catalogue](https://github.com/HaileyStorm/QRH-Catalogue)**, a public index of reusable QRH mathematics and formal components. I used it extensively in attaining these improvements. Source-backed contributions and corrections are welcome; the entries preserve exact source and evidence pointers.

The paper and archive retain the original credits, including OpenAI, Akash Levy, Hailey Collet's earlier work, Zhongpai Gao, timbalud, DaysSky, related arithmetic prepared for liqsweep, and ArviFoxy's two-level affine bootstrap. Hailey Collet is the sole human author of this contribution; research, drafting and Lean development were substantially AI-assisted.

**Author/contact:** Hailey Collet · HaileyCollet@gmail.com · [@HaileyStormC](https://x.com/HaileyStormC).
title: Standalone proof at theta 0.8747729897 with complete Lean sources and local evidence
